body: Open question answered: NeoTech/Camcraft is a **public** repo (checked 2026-11-08 with `gh repo view --json visibility`), so GitHub Pages is available on the free plan.

## Answer to open question 6 (screenshot pipeline) + one addition: example projects

**Q6: automated writer, not hand-captured.** The machinery already exists on `main` — the egui snapshot harness drives the real UI headlessly and compares PNGs against goldens (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs`, `UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1` regenerates deliberately, failures write `.new.png`/`.diff.png`). The 3D viewport can be captured headlessly too (`snapshot_rgba`, `crates/ui/tests/gpu_render.rs`). So docs images can come from the same golden-file pattern, with zero new CI: the staleness gate is an ordinary test in the existing tiers, regeneration is deliberate, and a UI change that leaves a stale doc image **fails the test**. Nothing drifts silently.

**The addition this issue's outline is missing: example parts.** The book can describe operations all day, but a user still has nothing to open. There is no `.camproj` anywhere in the repo today — no starter project to follow along with, and nothing to screenshot that isn't an empty shell.

Proposal, two pieces:

1. **`examples/` projects** — a "first part" project that runs the whole path the guide teaches: open a model → setup, stock, WCS anchor → tools → face + 2D pocket + drilling → simulate → post. Self-contained: model geometry is stored as embedded facets in the file (`crates/app/src/project/entity.rs:513`), so no side-car STL. Our own simple fixture (clean-room). Later: a turning example, a 3+2 example.
2. **Docs image tests** — one test that opens the example project through the real open command, steps through the operation order, and renders each step with the real viewport pipelines and the real toolpath display, writing one PNG per step into `docs/images/`. The pictures are golden files compared on every normal test run; `UPDATE_DOCS_IMAGES=1` re-renders and rewrites them — the same workflow as the kittest snapshots, no new tooling.

Together: every tutorial page becomes "open `examples/first-part.camproj`, follow the pictures" — and the pictures are provably current with the build.

Breakdown addition: one line — "Example project under `examples/` + a test that renders its steps into `docs/images/` as goldens (no new workflow)."

**I've built both as draft PR #525**: the example project (built end-to-end through the MCP server — model, stock, three ops, verify clean, posted NC) and the docs test (merged into the existing `gpu_render` binary so it shares its GPU lock and adds no new test process). Happy to rework to whatever the answers to the open questions say — images can move to `docs/guide/src/images/` the moment the mdbook scaffold lands.
